content: Metformin is considered a safe and effective first-line treatment for older adults with type 2 diabetes, provided their estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) is at least 30 mL/min/1.73 m². In individuals with impaired kidney function or those at an increased risk of developing lactic acidosis, careful monitoring and caution are necessary when prescribing metformin. Temporary discontinuation of metformin may be required in certain situations, such as prior to undergoing medical procedures or during episodes of acute illness, to minimize potential complications.
